metadata.diagonal_estimator: Forward: compute all vector-valued H[e_j,e_j] by nested JVPs. Gaussian: for z~N(0,I), average H[z,z] outer (z^2-1)/2. Coordinate: directly compute every development-averaged H[e_j,e_j]. Both use centered residual interventions.
metadata.operator_output: sum of target-layer residuals from the sampled source position through the penultimate token, matching the J-lens fitting reduction

split.split_rule: The development set is frozen to the two cases used for the original layer-6 forward-mode fit (typo_aganst, multihop_sushi), so the fitted operator is reused verbatim and the enlarged battery enters only the held-out side. No case was assigned using any lens output.
